deviations.what: Patents are dated by grant_year (fy = as.integer(grant_year)) instead of filing_year, so both windows and year t are placed on the wrong year; the spec says grant_year is not used by the measure.

notes: Everything else matches the spec: first-listed filter, dropping missing classes, base window t-5..t-1 and forward window t+1..t+3 (year t excluded), anti-join for new classes, NA when the base is empty and 0 when the forward set is empty, per-firm grouping, duplicate-proofing via unique(), and one collapsed row per firm_year with the five required columns. Treating an empty-string subclass as missing is an extra filter, but it is harmless.
